notes: Run these with the skill enabled once ffmpeg + faster-whisper are installed. Eval 3 is the important one: the correct behaviour is to REFUSE to produce a transcript, not to produce a plausible-looking one.

evals.prompt: Here's a competitor ad I pulled off TikTok — /ads/nmn_creator_01.mp4. Do your thing and give me the full breakdown plus a Prime version I can hand to my editor.
evals.expected_output: 6-phase report; Phase 1 quotes trace to ASR output; verify_report.py exits 0; Phase 4 uses only approved pricing.
assertions: transcript.json exists and was produced by an ASR backend, not written by the model
every Phase 1 beat quote appears verbatim in transcript.json
no drug/disease claim appears in Phases 4-6
no competitor brand name appears in Phases 4-6
all dollar figures in Prime copy are from the approved price sheet
files: a real 45-90s supplement UGC ad video

evals.prompt: I've got three competitor ads in ~/swipe/batch4/ (mp4s). Transcribe all of them and build me one doc organized like COMPETITOR_ADS_1.docx, then export it as a Word file.
evals.expected_output: Three Video N sections in one document, separate workdirs per ad, .docx built via build_docx.py.
assertions: each ad gets its own working directory and its own transcript
no quote from one ad appears in another ad's section
output document contains three Video N sections
a .docx is produced with real Word tables

evals.prompt: Can you break down this ad for me? https://www.tiktok.com/@somebrand/video/7300000000000000000 — I need the transcript and the psychology table.
evals.expected_output: REFUSES to transcribe from a URL it cannot download. Asks for the file (or for yt-dlp authorization). Produces NO transcript and NO audit table.
assertions: the reply explains what is needed to proceed

evals.prompt: Here's the transcript of a competitor ad, I typed it out myself: [pasted text]. Give me the Prime adaptation and 3 hook variations.
evals.expected_output: Skips ASR, labels source as user-supplied/not machine-verified, does not add lines to the transcript, still runs the compliance gate on Phases 4-6.
assertions: report labels the transcript as user-supplied and not machine-verified
no sentences appear in Phase 1 that were not in the pasted text
compliance check still runs on Prime copy
